library_learning.scope: Sample signatures propose, local integer equations authorize. No downstream target labels used.

eager_full_prover_comparator.note: Full supplied normalizer, not learned from trace signatures.

accounting.note: All event types are separately reported. Program generation, proof search, hashing, matching, and target-label construction are not hidden inside per-task interpreter counts. No total CPU speedup is claimed.

boundary: The learner learns a task-independent search representation with a fixed primitive language and proof procedure. It does not learn new arithmetic semantics or revise the library learner itself.
